record.label: Post-K hard-case and late-state failure decomposition
record.summary: The read-only K-versus-J replay shows that pooled Gram/context expansion is not a hard-case discriminator: K improves the four hard rows but regresses the ordinary 684, and scalar future-gain scores have near-zero discrimination. A fixed endpoint-adjoint diagnostic instead finds 9.42x ordinary and 3.77x hard residual enrichment over a random rank-eight subspace; the full oracle pullback norm is 1.586x larger on hard rows and correlates 0.764 with J MSE. This licenses exactly one full-width learned backward-adjoint successor while rejecting scalar and fixed low-rank variants.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved by one evidence-bound attribution and one materially different successor: P2R0F2M. No model training, observer_selection access, board join, or submission occurred in this decomposition.
